profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I am a Web developer since 2011, mostly focused on front end but also very familiar to back end with experience in automation testing, currently working at Microsoft Azure with React, in charge of translating UX designers' mock up's into life and boost existing application's performance as well as SME consulting for other teams within the organization.

I have experience as digital artist and game developer as well.

I’m a former pro athlete so if I’m not working or with my family I’m gonna be watching or playing sports.
